text:
Lina: Heads up — someone left the side door propped and we accidentally started a 3-person philosophy jam at 11:47. Who's the Door Villain? :grimacing:
Marco: Not me. I only open for pizza deliveries. :pizza:
Doorman Dan: I accept responsibility for being a living legend. New name proposal: The Vestibule of Intentions. Also instituting 'door karma' - if you prop, you owe a micro-ritual.
Sia: micro-ritual = tell a one-sentence life hack. I'm in. :sparkles:
Priya: vote for sticker that says "I tended the Vestibule". Low-effort merch please.
Zoe: also we need a tiny folding chair and a bell. The chair is for solemn thinking, the bell for ceremonies.
Lina: drafting the first draft of rules so we can paste into onboarding. quick version:
```
Vestibule Rules v1
- If you prop the side door you become Doorkeeper for up to 30 minutes.
- Doorkeeper duties: sweep crumbs, return stray umbrellas, offer tea and a life hack.
- Doorkeeper reward: one granola-token (redeemable with Doorman Dan).
- Initiate a midnight aphorism? Bring donuts.
```
Marco: petitioning to change "granola-token" to "granola voucher" for SEO. :joy:
Doorman Dan: ops-bot, can you run a poll? Options: Sticker / Mural / Nothing.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Vestibule take: Sticker, Mural, or Nothing?" React to cast vote.
Priya: voted Sticker. :white_check_mark:
Sia: voted Mural. :artist_palette:
Marco: voted Mural. :artist_palette:
Zoe: voted Sticker. :sparkles:
Lina: also snapped a pic of our ad-hoc meeting, uploading to #random-photos. https://files.redwood/vestibule_pic.jpg
Doorman Dan: ceremonial bell incoming. I will train Marco in the correct nod for new Doorkeepers.
Marco: I solemnly accept bell training. I will practice my nod in the mirror. :mirror:
Lina: ok this is now official lore. Adding to onboarding notes: "How to become a Doorkeeper and other vestibule rites."
Sia: love this. Next town hall: vestibule mural reveal? :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Vestibule poll closes in 24h". :bell:
